answer: Pay rewards only after a random audit: each epoch a few completed jobs are re-run by a panel the worker never chose, and the payout is held until the replay matches. A sybil farm built on one model behaves like a mirror, giving the same answers under every name, so a single failed replay links and voids the whole cluster. Fake names can wander between tasks, but the audit returns like a comet on a schedule they cannot predict, making each extra identity a fresh risk rather than free leverage.
